findings.message: PUT overshoots setpoint by +11.6 kPa near 3580 rpm (below the +20 kPa High line); primary zone — transient spike at 3580-3631 rpm: mean +11.6 / peak +11.6 kPa over 0.08 s (pull 14)
findings.title: Boost tracking

findings.message: PUT runs 4.9 kPa under setpoint on average (peak -8.9 kPa) for 4.72 s from 3699-6186 rpm (pull 14); the wastegate integral winds from -1.3% to 14.8% across the zone while the final command sits 15.9 points above the position feedforward (`wg_pos_base`) — the closed loop is carrying a shortfall the position feedforward is leaving, so the feedforward is commanding too little there
findings.title: Boost shortfall
